title: Connect Clover
summary: Connect your Clover POS with one sign-in, or with a Merchant ID and API token. RetailOps only reads; it never changes anything in Clover.

blocks.text: Go to Setup › **Integrations** and pick the **Clover** tile.

items: Choose **Connect with Clover**. Clover's sign-in page opens.
Sign in with the Clover owner account and approve RetailOps.
Clover sends you back to Integrations. The chip shows **Saved - not tested**; choose **Test connection**.

blocks.text: The sign-in link works for 10 minutes. If it runs out, choose Connect with Clover again.

items: In your Clover dashboard, open Account & Setup and copy the **Merchant ID** (13 letters and digits).
Under API Tokens, create a token with read permissions for inventory, orders, employees and merchant.
In RetailOps, enter the Merchant ID, paste the token, pick your region and choose **Save**, then **Test connection**.

blocks.text: An API token is meant for one store. If you run several stores on Clover, use Connect with Clover.

items: Sales: every order, its items, modifiers, discounts, refunds and order type, each night and through the day.
Items: names, barcodes, prices, cost and categories, plus stock counts (Clover keeps counts below zero).
Employees: names for open checks and reports.
Clover has no vendor field, so add who supplies each item on [Item vendors](page:item_vendors).

blocks.text: Choose **Disconnect** on the Clover card. Syncing stops and the saved token is deleted. Your past sales stay in RetailOps.
